verified.selectors.transport: unverified 2026-09-09: the web player is built from music-* custom elements; the transport's id and element name are a first guess, to be read off the live page
verified.controls: unverified 2026-09-09: candidate selectors for the transport's play / pause / next / previous; until they are confirmed the wall's Play and Pause fall through to the page's own Media Session handlers, which Amazon Music registers
verified.session: unverified 2026-09-09: signedOut = a sign-in link to amazon.com/ap/signin (seen on the signed-out web player); signedIn = a first guess at the account control, to be read off a signed-in page
verified.musicContext: not yet: the block shows the track from the Media Session metadata; which station or playlist it came from needs the live player's DOM
verified.musicLibrary: 2026-09-17: /my/playlists lists music-shoveler[primary-text=Your Playlists] music-vertical-item[primary-href=/my/playlists/<id>] (Cross Service, My Likes, Purchased) and a Followed Playlists shelf (Amazon's own, not editable, not listed); the Add to Playlist picker names the same lists the account may add to - the lookup reads it once per search and cancels it, so a list made a minute ago is in the menu without a visit to /my/playlists.
verified.js.ad-signals: not yet: Amazon Music Free plays ads; no audio-intermission capability is declared until the ad markers are seen live, so a break plays through unmuted for now
verified.musicLookup: 2026-09-17 on the live signed-in free-tier player: input#navbarSearchInput + Enter routes the player to /search/<term> without a reload; music-shoveler[primary-text=Songs] music-horizontal-item[primary-href^=/tracks/<id>] are the song rows (primary-text title, secondary-text artist, image-src art); the row's light-DOM music-button[icon-name=more] (its shadow button pressed) opens music-list-item[role=menuitem] options - Add to Playlist, View album, View artist, Share this song (no station item there); Add to Playlist opens div#dialog: with no playlist an h1 Create a New Playlist form (cancelled), else h3 Recents + a Create Playlist button + music-image-row[primary-text=<name>] rows whose div[role=button] adds - pressed live: music-notification-ribbon said '1 song was added to Cross Service playlist'. Never press a song's title: on the free tier it starts a shuffle play.
verified.musicStationFromSong: 2026-09-17 19:32 on the free tier: a song's page (/tracks/<id>, reached by the row's title link in the results, an SPA route) is the song MIX - h1 '<song> Mix', 'Shuffled With' - and the link's press starts it; the page's plain button[data-testid=Button,TrackDetail_TrackShuffleButton_Play] (aria-label Shuffle) is the fallback press. Pressed live: the Loneliness Mix played Save me (Remix) by Monaldin & Izzamuzzic. The transport names no collection for a mix (miniNPVTrackInfo secondary-text-2 empty), so musicContext reads the page's h1 while the mix page is up (kind station, id mix:<trackId>).

session.verified: signedIn: verified 2026-09-16 on the live signed-in player - the navbar's settings button (music-button#accountSetting, variant circle-image) carries the account's avatar as its image attribute; the page is web components and the earlier selectors (music-navbar, profile-menu) match nothing on it. signedOut: unverified - the sign-in control of a signed-out navbar, read from the 08:41 ap/signin redirect only.

notes: §32 music adapter slice (2026-09-09, first cut): transport is forwarded only on a human press (core pass-through), never on a timer; a missing control falls through to the service's own Media Session handlers. No ad-break signal yet, so no audio intermission on this source until the markers are verified on a signed-in free-tier run. Added on request as a fourth music source beside Apple Music, Spotify and Pandora. Cross-service lookup (2026-09-17, B-218): the page route like Pandora's and Spotify's - the player's own search box and the song row's own menu; Add to Playlist by the playlist's name in the picker; the station from a song is the song's own mix page (the row's title link opens it and starts it; the page's Shuffle is the fallback). English only for now: the menu items are matched by their English labels.
